# check-tree

> A Claude Code plugin and method for teams of AI coding agents: the plan is validated, turned into pass/fail checks the owner approves once, each agent gets one check and cannot finish while it fails, and progress is computed by running the checks. Stops agents from spinning and from declaring false "done". For developers and program managers using Claude Code. Free, MIT licensed.

## Install
claude plugin marketplace add goshawk-systems/check-tree
claude plugin install check-tree@check-tree
